about_the_game:
Dive into the gritty, action-packed world of Rusty Rangers with an electrifying soundtrack composed by Alexander Blynskiy (of make me insane). This adrenaline-fueled score blends intense synth-wave, gritty rock, and pulsating electronic beats to perfectly match the game’s chaotic battles, high-speed chases, and dystopian atmosphere.

From heart-pounding combat themes to haunting ambient tracks, Blynskiy’s music immerses players in a rust-covered wasteland where every shot, sprint, and explosion feels amplified by the driving rhythms and dark, cinematic melodies. Whether you're gunning down enemies or exploring desolate ruins, the Rusty Rangers soundtrack keeps the tension high and the energy relentless.

Composed by: Alexander Blynskiy (make me insane)
Genre: Synth-Rock / Electronic / Action

Original Soundtrack by Alexander Blynskiy / make me insane
